Meth A has vamp A, Meth B has vamp B.

Vamp A plays temptation on vamp B. Meth A gives vamp B SER. Temptation
triggers. Vamp B comes to Meth A, who uses vamp B to play Eternal Mask
on smudge. Smudge gets burnt via any useable method. vamp B is now a
vegetable, right?
